REGISTRY NOTES

Built from the pack, not a guess.

The catalog mirrors every entry in ATM10’s official Apotheosis enchantment registry configuration, including its adjusted maximum level. Some enchantments may be treasure-only, disabled from normal enchanting, or intended for special items—but remain valid registry IDs for commands.
